_comment: Static fallback for the shell guard when /api/kernel/gate is unreachable. Mirrors the shell patterns in the tier-1 commandment frontmatter so the guard fails closed for the most dangerous commands even when the portal is down. Regenerated by the installer from the wiki source of truth.

patterns.rationale: docker compose down -v drops named volumes including dpf_pgdata
docker volume rm removes Docker volumes including operator state
prisma migrate reset drops + recreates schema; wipes all rows
git reset --hard past committed work is destructive
rm -rf on a rooted absolute path is irreversible
